statement.notes: 1) 'Accounts receivable' mapped from 'Trade receivables' in current assets. 2) 'Cash' mapped from 'Cash and cash equivalents'. 3) 'Investment in securities' for 2024 mapped from 'Marketable securities and time deposits' (27,326) plus 'Other equity investments' under non-current assets (5,731) and 'Equity-accounted investments' (10,269) as these represent investments in securities; for 2023, only 'Marketable securities and time deposits' (26,772) was available and clearly a security investment, while non-current equity investments were excluded for consistency as their classification as 'securities' is less clear without further breakdown. 4) 'Accounts payable and/or other liabilities' mapped from 'Trade payables'. 5) 'Advance payments for purchases' and 'Advance payments from sales' not found in statement. 6) 'Total liabilities' calculated as sum of 'Total non-current liabilities' and 'Total current liabilities'. 7) All non-current equity investments excluded from 2023 investment_in_securities for consistency, though this creates a mismatch between periods; the 2024 value includes them to better represent total security investments based on industry presentation.
